tours.name: Set an Employee's Approvers
tours.description: Learn how to choose who approves an employee's time off requests, by setting the approver on the employee record.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to choose who approves an employee's time off requests, by setting the approver on the employee record.

steps.title: Open Employees
steps.description: Approvers are chosen on the employee record. They decide who can approve this person's requests.

description_i18n.en_US: Approvers are chosen on the employee record. They decide who can approve this person's requests.

steps.title: Open an employee
steps.content: Click an employee to open the record.

content_i18n.en_US: Click an employee to open the record.

steps.description: Every employee has their own approvers for time off, expenses, timesheets and attendance.

description_i18n.en_US: Every employee has their own approvers for time off, expenses, timesheets and attendance.

steps.title: Work Information tab
steps.description: The Approvers section is on this tab, under the work address and location.

description_i18n.en_US: The Approvers section is on this tab, under the work address and location.

steps.title: Time Off approver
steps.content: Click the Time Off field to open the list of users.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the Time Off field to open the list of users.

steps.description: The Time Off approver is the person who receives and approves this employee's leave requests. Only users with the right to approve can be chosen.

description_i18n.en_US: The Time Off approver is the person who receives and approves this employee's leave requests. Only users with the right to approve can be chosen.

steps.title: Choose the approver
steps.content: Click the user you want as approver.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the user you want as approver.

steps.description: Pick the employee's manager or the person responsible for approving their leave. The same approver does not have to be used for expenses or timesheets.

description_i18n.en_US: Pick the employee's manager or the person responsible for approving their leave. The same approver does not have to be used for expenses or timesheets.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon to keep the approver.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon to keep the approver.

steps.description: From now on the leave requests of this employee are sent to this approver.

description_i18n.en_US: From now on the leave requests of this employee are sent to this approver.
